name: pl.finwire/data
title: finwire.pl - Polish financial data
description: Live Polish rates, FX, housing prices, rents, credit market, legal limits and macro data.

tools.name: get_macro_snapshot
tools.description: Use for a general view of the Polish economy or a briefing. For one indicator, use get_macro_indicator. Returns the six headline indicators (GDP, inflation, unemployment, wages, rates and similar) with latest reading, change and freshness, which indicators changed recently, and the next releases and RPP meetings.

tools.name: list_macro_indicators
tools.description: Use first to find the key of a macro indicator. Then use get_macro_indicator with that key. Find indicators and their keys. Latest reading, change, next release and source for GDP, CPI and core inflation, unemployment, wages, retail sales, industrial output, NBP rates, FX, consumer sentiment, mortgage market and statutory limits. Filter by group or free text (Polish or English words, e.g. "inflacja", "wages"). Set include_descriptions to learn what each series measures when keys look alike (cpi-rr vs hicp-rr).

query.description: Case-insensitive text matched against key and label.

include_descriptions.description: Add a one-sentence explanation per indicator. Default false.

tools.name: get_macro_indicator
tools.description: Use for the value, the meaning or the trend of one macro indicator. One indicator by key with its meaning, latest reading, freshness, next release and history (oldest first) with min and max over the window.

from.description: First month of history, YYYY-MM. Default: last 5 years.

tools.name: compare_macro_indicators
tools.description: Use for 2-4 macro series side by side, for example inflation and wages. History of 2-4 indicators aligned by period. All keys must have the same frequency (all monthly, or all quarterly); otherwise the call fails and says which differ.

keys.description: 2-4 indicator keys from list_macro_indicators. All keys must have the same frequency.

from.description: First month of history, YYYY-MM. Default: last 5 years.

tools.name: get_macro_changes
tools.description: Use when the user asks what is new in macro data. Indicators whose reading was updated in the last N days (newest first), with the change against the previous reading.

tools.name: get_macro_calendar
tools.description: Use for the dates of the next macro releases and RPP meetings. For tax deadlines, use get_legal_changes or get_compliance_calendar. Upcoming Polish macro releases and decisions (RPP rate decisions, CPI, wages, GDP, industrial output) with date, time and importance (higher is more important). Dates marked tentative may move.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Use when no other tool is applicable. Then use get_dataset with the id from the result. Catalog of all finwire.pl datasets (rates, FX, gold, fuel and energy prices, Finwire Nowcast, broker fees, housing prices and rents, credit market, legal limits and law changes, regional income, Europe) with the best tool to call, its parameters, license and finwire.pl page.

query.description: Words in Polish or English, e.g. "czynsze", "mortgage", "podatek".

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Use after search_datasets, and only when no dedicated tool is applicable. Any dataset by id from search_datasets, with optional params listed there. Returns the same data as the public REST API /v1 (long lists shortened).

params.description: Optional parameters of the dataset, e.g. {"city": "gdansk"}.

tools.name: get_interest_rates
tools.description: Use for NBP policy rates. For bank offers, use get_bank_rates. Current NBP policy rates (reference, lombard, deposit, rediscount, discount) with the date of the last change, or the history of one rate. WIBOR and POLSTR are not available (GPW Benchmark license).

rate.description: Rate id for history, e.g. "stopa-referencyjna". Omit for all current rates.

tools.name: get_currency_rates
tools.description: Use for exchange rates, customs exchange rates (customs=true), the most expensive currencies (ranking=true) and the gold price. Use fineness=true for the price of 1 g of gold 585, 750 or other fineness and for the gold ounce price in USD. NBP mid, bid and ask rates of currencies against PLN (table), the history of one currency (table A daily, table B weekly, e.g. RUB, AED), the NBP gold price (code "XAU"), the gold price by fineness and the troy ounce in USD (fineness=true), customs exchange rates (customs=true): NBP table A rate of the penultimate Wednesday of a month, used for customs value in the next month, or the ranking of the most expensive currencies (ranking=true): NBP tables A and B of the same day, place 52 weeks earlier.

code.description: ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD, CHF, RUB; "XAU" for gold. Omit for the main currencies.

days.description: History window in days for one currency, default 90.

customs.description: true: customs exchange rates of the current and next month. With code: one currency.

fineness.description: true: price of 1 g of gold of each fineness legal in Poland (999, 960, 750, 585, 500, 375, 333) with karats, and the price of a troy ounce in USD, now and a year ago. Code is XAU or omitted.

ranking.description: true: most expensive currencies against PLN from NBP tables A and B. With code: the place of one currency.

tools.name: get_statutory_interest
tools.description: Use for statutory, late payment, maximum, tax arrears and B2B invoice interest rates in Poland. For NBP rates only, use get_interest_rates. Polish interest rates set by law from NBP rates: statutory (capital) and late payment interest (Civil Code), maximum interest, interest on tax arrears with the reduced rate (Tax Ordinance), late payment interest in commercial transactions (B2B invoices). Each rate has the date from which it applies and the next rate (announced after an RPP decision, or the B2B rate for the next half-year: settled or a finwire.pl estimate).

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Use for the maximum fuel prices that the state sets and for crude oil prices (Brent, WTI) in USD and PLN. For average prices in shops, use get_retail_prices. topic max: maximum retail prices of Pb95, Pb98 and diesel in PLN per litre announced by the Minister of Energy in Monitor Polski: price in force, next day price if announced, and recent history. topic oil: Brent and WTI crude oil spot prices (U.S. Energy Information Administration) in USD and PLN per barrel at the NBP mid rate of the trading day, week, month and year change, 52-week range, Ropa Brent w złotych finwire (finwire_brent_pln), and recent weeks of Polish pump prices (European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin) next to the crude cost per litre. Default all.

history.description: Number of past maximum price announcements, default 7.

tools.name: get_retail_prices
tools.description: Use for prices in shops, for example butter, bread or milk, for the shopping basket and for excise duty (akcyza) in the price of cigarettes, alcohol and fuel. Average retail prices of 30 goods and services in Poland from GUS (bread, butter, milk, eggs, meat, vegetables, sugar, electricity, gas, heating, petrol, diesel, bus ticket, taxi, haircut, doctor visit, cinema) for the latest month, with change vs the previous month and the same month a year earlier and the minutes of work each costs at the average net wage; plus the finwire shopping basket of 10 staple foods (finwire_shopping_basket_index). Also excise duty (akcyza) and VAT in the price of a pack of cigarettes, vodka, beer, wine (GUS yearly prices) and a litre of petrol and diesel at the rates in force today, announced excise rate changes (alcohol, tobacco, e-cigarettes, fuel) and the share of excise in the cigarette pack price (finwire_cigarette_excise_share).

product.description: Product name in Polish, e.g. "masło", "chleb", "benzyna"; returns that item with its monthly price history. Omit for all items.

tools.name: get_pension_stats
tools.description: Use for the average ZUS pension paid now, disability and survivor pensions, sickness allowances, and the dates when ZUS pays pensions (payment calendar, holidays, 800+). For a future pension, use get_pension_forecast. Average old-age pension paid by ZUS (gross and net), disability and survivor pensions, number of pensioners, sickness and maternity allowances, the pension to wage ratio finwire_pension_wage_ratio, CPI, minimum pension and indexations, monthly from preliminary ZUS data (without KRUS and uniformed services). Also the ZUS payment calendar: the next payment for each payment day, with dates moved before weekends and public holidays, 800+ payment deadlines, the social pension (renta socjalna) and the conditions of the ZUS top-up to the minimum pension (art. 87: age 60/65, 20/25 years of service).

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

payment_day.description: Day of the month in the ZUS pension decision, e.g. 10; returns the payment dates for this day in the next 12 months.

tools.name: get_average_pole
tools.description: Use for the typical or average person in Poland: median age, wage, flat, mortgage, pension, spending and car. Profile of the typical person in Poland (finwire_average_pole) built from the latest official readings: median age (Eurostat), median gross and net wage (GUS), median price per m2 of a flat (GUS), average new mortgage (BIK), model monthly mortgage payment, average ZUS pension, spending per person (GUS household budgets), car age classes (Eurostat) and the most registered car brand. Each trait carries its measure (median, mean, model, distribution, most frequent) and its own data period.

tools.name: get_daily_price_index
tools.description: Use for daily online prices of a basket of food, household and personal care products. For official CPI, use get_macro_indicator. Experimental daily index of online shelf prices of a fixed basket of food, drinks, household and personal care products in three Polish online shops (finwire_daily_price_index), base month = 100: latest value and change since the base month, basket categories with change since the base month and month on month, categories with the largest rise and fall, monthly readings, the food part vs GUS CPI food and non-alcoholic beverages for the same completed month, a shop comparison (the same index computed from the quotes of each shop: change since the base month and vs a month earlier, category changes per shop next to GUS CPI of the same category), and the collection state (days, products, stores, expected first reading) while the base month is being collected. Online prices only, not CPI; no prices of single products or shops.

tools.name: get_pension_forecast
tools.description: Use for the future ZUS pension of a person and the replacement rate by birth year, sex and wage. For pensions paid now, use get_pension_stats. Model of the first gross ZUS pension in Poland (finwire_pension_forecast) by birth year 1966-2006, profile (k60 = woman retiring at 60, k65 = woman at 65, m65 = man at 65) and wage level (minimalna = minimum wage, mediana = median wage, przecietna = average wage, dwukrotnosc = twice the average): replacement rate vs own last gross wage and vs the average wage, pension in today's money (rate x today's average wage), P10/P50/P90 from thousands of simulations of wage growth and the number of workers. Built from the statutory indexation of the ZUS account and subaccount (real history since 2000), Eurostat EUROPOP working-age population and life expectancy, the GUS life table and Ministry of Finance wage assumptions; with the effect of the shrinking workforce and of longer life, and OECD and European Commission benchmarks. Without arguments returns the headline (man, average wage, retiring 30 years after the base year). Full career from age 22; a model, not an individual ZUS statement.

profile.description: k60 woman retiring at 60, k65 woman at 65, m65 man at 65; default m65.

threshold.description: Wage level: minimum wage, median, average, twice the average; default przecietna.

tools.name: get_investment_funds
tools.description: Use for investment fund assets and net flows: equity, bond, mixed and PPK funds. Assets, purchases of units, redemptions and net flows of investment funds in Poland from monthly IZFiA data: whole market, fund groups (short-term bond, bond, equity, mixed, PPK, target date, absolute return, commodity, crypto assets, private market) with IZFiA profiles, bond funds by type, equity funds by region, net flows since January and over 12 months, and the finwire index finwire_fund_flows_index (12-month net flows as % of assets a year earlier). Amounts in PLN million. Informational data, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_business_registrations
tools.description: Use for the number of new, closed and suspended sole proprietorships (CEIDG). To start a business, use plan_business_entry or get_business_guide. Monthly applications filed in CEIDG, the Polish register of sole proprietorships (Ministry of Development and Technology data on dane.gov.pl): registrations of new sole proprietorships, closures (deregistrations), suspensions and resumptions, registrations minus closures, the latest month against the same month in earlier years, the share of women among founders, sums since January and over 12 months, and the finwire index finwire_new_business_ratio (registration applications per 100 closure applications over 12 months; above 100 the number of firms grows). Counts of applications, not of firms in the register; companies registered in KRS are not included.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_vehicle_registrations
tools.description: Use for car registrations, car brands and Chinese car brands. First registrations of vehicles in Poland, monthly since 2014, from the Ministry of Digital Affairs files with CEPiK data: passenger cars and all vehicles, 17 vehicle types, provinces per 1000 residents, top passenger-car brands of the month and of 12 months (nationwide or one province) and the share of brands from China by province, with the finwire indices finwire_car_registrations_pulse (12-month passenger cars, change year on year) and finwire_chinese_brands_share. A first registration in Poland covers new cars and used cars imported from abroad. Months with an inconsistent province or type split are held back and listed. For electric cars use get_electric_vehicles.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

province.description: Province TERYT code 02-32 (e.g. 14 = mazowieckie) for the brand ranking; default Poland.

period.description: Month YYYY-MM of the brand ranking; default latest.

tools.name: get_electric_vehicles
tools.description: Use for the number of electric cars (BEV, PHEV) by year, county and province. Battery electric (BEV) and plug-in hybrid (PHEV) passenger cars in Poland: fleet at year end and new cars in the year with shares (Eurostat), fuel mix of new cars, provinces and counties per 1000 passenger cars with top and bottom counties (GUS BDL, when the county series is available), and the correlation of public charging sites per 10k residents with BEV per 1000 cars across counties, with a 95% interval and a version controlling the median wage. Correlation is not causation. Index finwire_ev_share_new_cars. For charging points use get_ev_charging.

counties.description: Include every county (about 380 rows); default false = top and bottom 10.

tools.name: get_ev_charging
tools.description: Use for statistics of EV charging points in Poland, provinces and counties. For chargers near a place, use find_ev_chargers. Public EV charging in Poland from the UDT register EIPA: locations, stations and charging points today and at each month end since December 2019, growth year on year, charging sites and fast sites (at least 50 kW) by province and county, sites per 10k residents, sites by maximum power class (EU AFIR: up to 22 kW, 23-49, 50-149, 150-349, 350+ kW) and connector (CCS, Type 2, CHAdeMO), counties with the most ultra-fast sites (150 kW and more), networks with the most fast sites, the finwire index finwire_ev_charging_coverage (charging points per 1000 BEV and PHEV cars in the fleet), growth records and the finwire index finwire_ev_infrastructure_growth (charging points year on year), and daily growth by power class and network since the start of measurement. Interactive map with every site: finwire.pl/mapa-ladowarek.

history.description: Number of past month ends in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: find_ev_chargers
tools.description: Use to find EV chargers near a place: fast, free or available chargers. Public EV charging sites in Poland from the UDT register EIPA near a city or a point: give city, or lat and lon with radius_km. Filters: min_kw (e.g. 150 for ultra-fast), free_charging, available_now (at least one point free according to a status younger than 2 hours), network slug, connector (ccs, chademo, type2). Each site: name, address, network, power class (AFIR), maximum kW, points, points free now, lowest ad hoc price per kWh (price for a driver without a contract), distance. Pass id for one site with stations, points, connectors, prices and status. Operators report data; check the price at the charger.

city.description: City, e.g. "Kraków" (with or without Polish letters).

available_now.description: Only sites with a point free right now.

network.description: Network slug, e.g. greenway, orlen, tesla, ionity.

connector.description: Only sites with this connector type.

id.description: Site id from a previous result for the full site card.

tools.name: get_ev_charging_prices
tools.description: Use for the EV charging price per kWh and network price lists. Ad hoc EV charging prices in Poland (for a driver without a contract) reported by operators to the UDT register EIPA: median price per kWh with point counts by power class (AC up to 22 kW, DC below 50 kW, DC 50-149 kW, from 150 kW), AC vs DC, cheapest and most expensive networks, share of points with a per-minute fee, recent price changes and the finwire index finwire_ev_charging_price_index. With network: that network's price list by power class and its price changes. Subscriptions and app tariffs can be cheaper and are not included.

network.description: Network slug, e.g. greenway, orlen, ionity, tesla; omit for the whole market.

tools.name: get_ike_ikze_stats
tools.description: Use for the IKE and IKZE market: accounts, assets, contributions by institution type and average balance. IKE and IKZE (Polish individual retirement accounts with tax relief) from half-yearly KNF data: number of accounts and assets, split by institution type (insurers, investment funds, brokers, banks, voluntary pension funds), accounts opened, contributions, withdrawals and returns since January, holders by sex and age, average annual contribution as % of the statutory annual limit (December states), and the finwire index finwire_ike_ikze_avg_balance (average balance per account). Amounts in PLN. For the contribution limits themselves use get_legal_limits. Informational data, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past half-yearly states in the summary, default 6.

tools.name: get_car_insurance_market
tools.description: Use for the average price of car insurance (OC and autocasco) in Poland, its trend and the size of the market. Tell the user that this is a market average and not a quote for one driver. Average car insurance premium in Poland from the quarterly KNF bulletin "Rynek ubezpieczeń" (part D): average gross written premium per policy for OC (motor third-party liability, insurance class 10) and autocasco (AC, class 3) over the last 4 quarters and in the last quarter, change vs a year earlier, policies written and in force, claims paid per 100 PLN of premium in the same window, claims paid per settled claim, the 18 non-life insurance classes, quarterly history and the finwire index finwire_oc_avg_premium. Amounts in PLN. These are market averages: they are not a price quote for a specific driver or car. Informational data, not insurance advice.

history.description: Number of past quarters in the summary, default 8.

tools.name: get_banking_sector
tools.description: Use for the profit of Polish banks as a sector, net interest income, bank tax paid on profit, impaired housing and consumer loans and household deposits. Do not use for the data of one bank. Polish banking sector from KNF monthly data (FINREP): net profit year-to-date with change vs the same months a year earlier, net profit in the latest month and over 12 months, gross profit, tax as % of gross profit, net interest and fee income, operating costs vs income, impairment, the finwire index finwire_bank_interest_share (net interest income / total operating income over 12 months: how much bank income depends on interest rates), household housing and consumer loan portfolios with impaired loans (IFRS 9 stage 3) and household deposits. Group: whole sector (default), commercial banks, branches of foreign credit institutions or cooperative banks. Amounts in PLN. Informational data about the sector, not about one bank and not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 6.

tools.name: get_subsidy_stats
tools.description: Use for Czyste Powietrze heating subsidies: applications, contracts and payments. Czyste Powietrze (Clean Air), the Polish subsidy programme for replacing heating sources and thermal modernisation of single-family houses, from the weekly NFOŚiGW summary: applications, contracts and paid subsidies cumulative (all editions and the Modernisation Fund edition), last week, completed contracts, bank loan grants, requested heat sources by type, the payout queue (contracted but not yet paid) with weekly pace, and finwire_clean_air_payout_rate (paid as % of contracted). National data only.

history.description: Number of past readings in the summary, default 8.

tools.name: get_retail_bond_premium
tools.description: Use to compare retail savings bonds with bank deposits after tax. For the rate of a bond in the next year or month, use get_bond_next_rate. Premia obligacji skarbowych finwire (finwire_retail_bond_premium): by how much the first-year rate of Polish State Treasury retail savings bonds (OTS, ROR, DOR, TOS, COI, EDO; family ROS and ROD separately) exceeds the finwire deposit index (best 3-month deposits), the finwire savings account index and the average new household term deposit (NBP MIR), after the Polish capital gains tax (Belka tax, rate in taxRate) on both sides, in percentage points; monthly retail bond debt change (Ministry of Finance), household term deposits change (NBP) and a sales response test on our own series. Describes the rate gap only, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_bond_next_rate
tools.description: Use for the rate of Polish savings bonds (EDO, COI, ROR, DOR, ROS, ROD) in the next interest period, for example "what will my EDO pay from December" or "what will COI pay in the next year". If the user gives the purchase month, use type and purchase_month. If the state is estimate, tell the user that it is a model estimate. If the state is unknown, give knownFrom. Finwire Bondcast (finwire_bond_next_rate): the interest rate of Polish State Treasury retail savings bonds in the next interest period, from the rules in the Ministry of Finance issue letters. COI, EDO, ROS and ROD from the 2nd year: margin + GUS CPI y/y for month M-2 (M = first month of the period), zero if CPI is negative. ROR and DOR each month: NBP reference rate on the 10th working day before the month + margin. Each period has a state: announced (Ministry of Finance interest table), known (rate from the formula with a published input), estimate (GUS flash CPI, Finwire Nowcast CPI with an 80% interval, or scenarios of the next RPP decision) or unknown (no number; knownFrom gives the date of the exact rate). Without arguments: the index (2nd year of EDO bought 12 months before next month), periods that start in the next 3 months by bond type, the formula inputs and how the Ministry of Finance followed RPP decisions. With series, or with type and purchase_month: all interest periods of that series. A series code is the type + month and year of maturity (EDO bought in December 2025 = EDO1235). Informational data, not investment advice.

series.description: Series code, e.g. EDO1235, COI1129, ROR1127 (type + MMYY of maturity).

type.description: Bond type. Use with purchase_month when the user does not know the series code.

purchase_month.description: Month of purchase 'YYYY-MM'. Use with type.

tools.name: get_fixed_cost_burden
tools.description: Use for the share of household income that goes to the mortgage, admin fees and utilities, by province. Sztywne koszty gospodarstwa finwire (finwire_fixed_cost_burden): share of net income of a model household (two earners on the regional median wage) taken by the mortgage payment on a 50 m2 flat in the province capital, administrative fee, heating, water, waste, electricity and TV licence; Poland and 16 provinces, monthly, with the share without the mortgage.

region.description: 'polska' or province slug, e.g. mazowieckie, slaskie, kujawsko_pomorskie; omit for all regions.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary for the region (Poland when omitted), default 12.

tools.name: get_municipal_budget
tools.description: Use for the budget of one municipality: what it spends money on, its debt and its EU funds. Pieniądze Twojej gminy (finwire_gmina_spending_per_capita): for one Polish municipality (gmina) or city with county rights - executed spending per resident by category (schools, social help, family benefits and nurseries, roads, waste and water, administration, culture, sport, municipal housing, fire brigades, interest on debt) vs neighbouring municipalities, municipalities of similar type and size and Poland (Ministry of Finance Rb-28S, last full year and current year to date), investment share, debt per resident at the end of the latest quarter (Rb-Z), EU funding per resident 2021-2027 and 2014-2020 with the largest projects (only projects located in one municipality; natural persons are not named). Without a municipality: national figures; with metric: ranking.

municipality.description: Municipality name (e.g. "Kraków", "Bielsk Podlaski") or 7-digit TERYT code. Omit for national figures or a ranking.

metric.description: Ranking instead of one municipality: total, invest, debt, eu or a category (oswiata, pomoc, rodzina, drogi, komunalne, administracja, kultura, sport, mieszkania, bezpieczenstwo, dlug, pozostale).

family.description: Ranking of municipalities (default) or of cities with county rights.

tools.name: get_heating_season
tools.description: Use for the heating season: degree days, the cold of this winter against the norm, and the heating bill forecast. Indeks chłodu sezonu finwire (finwire_heating_season_index) and Koszt sezonu grzewczego finwire (finwire_heating_season_cost): heating degree days since 1 July (Eurostat method, IMGW-PIB synoptic stations) vs the 20-season norm for Poland and 17 cities, cold index (100 = norm, below = warmer), season forecast with an 80% interval only when the backtest gate passes (otherwise the reason), season heating cost of a 100 m2 house (gas, heat pump, coal, district heating), monthly means vs norm, coldest and warmest seasons since 1966/67.

city.description: 'polska' or city slug: warszawa, krakow, wroclaw, gdansk, poznan, lodz, katowice, torun, lublin, bialystok, szczecin, rzeszow, olsztyn, kielce, opole, zielona-gora, gorzow-wielkopolski. Gdynia and Sopot use gdansk, Bydgoszcz torun, Gliwice katowice. Omit for Poland with all cities.

tools.name: get_ppk_stats
tools.description: Use for PPK workplace pensions: participants, participation rate, net assets, average account and fees. PPK (Pracownicze Plany Kapitałowe), the Polish auto-enrolment workplace pension programme, from the monthly PFR Portal PPK bulletin (PPK Register kept by PFR): net assets of target date funds, active accounts, participants, employers running PPK, participation rate, average management fee, number of financial institutions and finwire_ppk_avg_account (Średnie konto PPK finwire: net assets per active account), with monthly history.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_public_debt
tools.description: Use for public debt, State Treasury debt, debt per person and the budget deficit. For EU countries, use get_eu_public_debt. State Treasury debt of Poland at the end of the latest month (Ministry of Finance): amount, change, debt per resident finwire_public_debt_per_capita, average growth per second over 12 months, domestic/foreign and retail bonds; national public debt and general government debt % of GDP (quarterly); state budget deficit cumulative from January with the plan from the budget act and the same period a year earlier.

history.description: Number of past months of debt history in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: list_finwire_indices
tools.description: Use for a list of all finwire indices (id finwire_*) with the latest values. Give the id and the method version from the citation field. All indices computed by finwire.pl, each under a stable id finwire_* (e.g. finwire_mortgage_barometer, finwire_credit_capacity_index, finwire_deposit_rate_index, finwire_savings_rate_index, finwire_rcn_price_index, finwire_price_gap_index, finwire_entry_threshold_index, finwire_credit_market_index, finwire_nowcast, finwire_legal_calendar): latest reading with its period, change vs the previous reading, method version and citation. Use get_finwire_index for one index with history.

group.description: Group: kredyt (credit), oszczednosci (savings), mieszkania (housing), rynek (market and forecasts), prawo (law).

status.description: live (default) = with a reading; planned = id reserved, in preparation.

tools.name: get_finwire_index
tools.description: Use for one finwire index with history. Find the id with list_finwire_indices. Give the id and the method version from the citation field. One finwire index by its id finwire_* (old dataset ids such as credit-market-index, borrowing-power or credit-stress are accepted as aliases): latest and previous reading with periods, change, method version, sources, citation formula and history. Indices computed from WIBOR publish only the result.

id.description: finwire_* id or alias from list_finwire_indices, for example "finwire_entry_threshold_index".

history.description: History points, default 12.

tools.name: get_nowcast
tools.description: Use for the next CPI or core inflation value and the next RPP decision. Tell the user that this is a model estimate. Give the interval or the probabilities, and the accuracy. For past accuracy, prefer the live track record over the backtest. Write the source as "Finwire Nowcast (finwire.pl)". Finwire Nowcast (finwire id: finwire_nowcast), the finwire.pl statistical model of the next official readings: CPI inflation y/y and core inflation y/y (point and 80% interval) and probabilities of a cut, no change or hike at the next RPP (Monetary Policy Council) meeting. Recomputed daily, frozen 3 working days before publication, then settled against the actual reading; with backtest accuracy vs naive benchmarks and the live track record (each forecast published before the reading vs the first official reading). A model estimate, not a consensus and not investment advice.

indicator.description: One indicator; omit for all three.

history.description: Recent settled or backtest points per indicator, default 6.

tools.name: get_lead_forecasts
tools.description: Use for core inflation in 6-12 months and for impaired (Stage 3) housing and consumer loans in 2-4 quarters. Give the 80% interval and the backtest coverage. If published is false, there is no forecast to give. Two finwire.pl models with 80% intervals. finwire_cost_pressure (Presja kosztowa finwire): NBP core inflation y/y in 6 and 12 months from a unit labour cost proxy, producer prices and the EUR/PLN change. finwire_npl_forecast (Stres kredytowy wyprzedzający finwire): share of impaired (IFRS 9 Stage 3, KNF) housing and consumer loans in 2 and 4 quarters from the WIBOR 3M change, unemployment and the portfolio trend. A forecast is shown only when at least 70% of actual readings fell inside the 80% interval in the rolling backtest; otherwise published is false and only the accuracy statistics are given. A model estimate, not investment advice.

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.description: Use for regulated electricity and gas tariffs in Poland. For prices in the EU, use get_europe_data. Household electricity and gas tariffs approved by URE and in force today: electricity energy price of the default seller and distribution rates per operator for G11, G12 and G12w with cheaper-zone hours and fees; gas fuel price, subscription and PSG distribution rates per tariff area for W-1.1 to W-4. Net amounts, VAT rate given; each with the URE decision and PDF.

area.description: Filter by distribution operator or gas tariff area, e.g. "Tauron", "Stoen", "warszawski".

date.description: Day YYYY-MM-DD for which tariffs in force are selected; default today.

tools.name: calc_gas_bill
tools.description: Use for the gas bill of a household in Poland from its yearly use in kWh or m3. For the tariff rates only, use get_energy_prices. Yearly and monthly gas bill of a Polish household from the URE tariffs in force today (default seller fuel price and subscription, PSG distribution per tariff area), split into energy, distribution and fixed fees, with VAT. Give the yearly use in kWh or in m3; m3 are converted with the factor from the invoice or, without it, with the factor the PSG tariff uses for high-methane gas. When URE has approved the next tariff, the same use is also priced in the new tariff.

annualKwh.description: Yearly gas use in kWh (from the invoice). Give this or annualM3.

annualM3.description: Yearly gas use in m3. Give this or annualKwh.

factor.description: Conversion factor kWh/m3 from the invoice; only with annualM3.

area.description: PSG tariff area: key (GD, PO, TA, WA, WR, ZA) or name, e.g. "warszawski". Omit for all 6 areas.

group.description: Tariff group from the invoice; default from the yearly use (PSG thresholds in m3).

tools.name: get_broker_fees
tools.description: Use for brokerage account fees. Fees of brokers available to Polish investors from their official fee tables: online order commission on Warsaw (GPW), US and German stocks and ETFs, account and currency conversion fees, IKE/IKZE and investor protection, with the fee table URL and the date it was last confirmed. Facts only, no ranking or recommendation.

broker.description: Filter by broker name or id, e.g. "XTB", "mbank".

market.description: Show the commission of one market only.

tools.name: get_housing_prices
tools.description: Use for flat prices per m2 in a city or district, and with property "land" for building plot prices per m2 in a voivodeship or county. Transaction prices of flats per square meter from notarial deeds (RCN): median, quartiles, year-over-year change and number of deeds in 17 cities, or per district of one city. property "land" gives building plot prices per m2 from notarial deeds instead: Poland and 16 voivodeships, or with voivodeship its counties (10-are plot price, distance to the capital), rural vs urban areas and a quarterly trend. source "gus" gives the GUS quarterly series instead. view "location-premium" gives finwire_location_premium: per district, how far the actual price deviates from the price expected from neighbourhood quality (transport, schools, shops, greenery, quiet, air), with model fit and accuracy; without city, the status of every city. The quarterly finwire indices finwire_rcn_price_index and finwire_price_gap_index: get_finwire_index.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") for its districts; omit for all cities.

voivodeship.description: With property "land": voivodeship, e.g. "mazowieckie"; omit for all 16.

tools.name: get_city_flat_prices
tools.description: Use for the cheapest or the most expensive cities to buy a flat in Poland, and for flat prices per m2 in a city that is not one of the 17 large cities, for example Gliwice, Toruń or Częstochowa. For districts of a large city, use get_housing_prices. Median flat transaction price per m² from notarial deeds (RCN) in Polish cities with at least 200 deeds in the last 4 full quarters and no quarter gaps, from the cheapest: quartiles, median flat area and price, secondary and primary market, year-over-year change and the median asking price per m² in developer price lists (dane.gov.pl) in the same city. Without city: the cheapest and the most expensive cities, the number of cities and all cities with their median. With city: that city with its rank and quarterly medians (all markets, secondary, primary). Aggregates only, no individual deeds.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") for one city with its rank and quarterly medians; omit for the ranking.

tools.name: get_rents
tools.description: Use for rents and rental yield. Asking rents (median, per m², month-over-month change) in Polish cities and districts, with gross and net rental yield and payback period.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") for its districts; omit for all cities.

tools.name: get_housing_carry
tools.description: Use to find if rent covers mortgage interest in a city (net yield minus mortgage rate). Carry nieruchomości finwire (finwire_housing_carry): per Polish city, the net rental yield of a typical 2-room flat (after one vacant month, flat-rate rental tax, admin fee in vacant months and property tax) minus the variable mortgage interest rate, in percentage points, monthly with history, plus net rent minus first-year interest in PLN per month for a loan covering the whole price. Negative carry = interest exceeds net rent; buying to let on credit then relies on price growth. For rents and plain yields use get_rents. Informational data, not investment advice.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") to get one city with its monthly history; omit for all cities.

tools.name: get_cost_of_living
tools.description: Use for how much it costs per month to live in a Polish city (family of 2+1, renting or owning) and to compare cities for a move. Give the period of each component; living expenses are a Poland average. Koszt życia w mieście finwire (finwire_city_cost_of_living): monthly cost of housing and living of a family of 2 adults and 1 child in 17 Polish cities, renting a 3-room flat (median asking rent) or owning it without a mortgage, ranked from the cheapest. Components with periods: rent, owners association fee, central heating, water, waste and electricity (GUS rates), property tax at the upper limit, living expenses outside housing (GUS household budget survey, Poland average, indexed with CPI), flat price per m2 (RCN deeds) and years of rent to buy. For rents only use get_rents, for running costs only get_housing_costs.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") to get one city with the full breakdown; omit for all cities.

tools.name: get_housing_balance
tools.description: Use for housing demand against supply, the completions forecast and the rent forecast. finwire housing balance for Poland and 17 cities: finwire_housing_pressure (new residents per 1 dwelling completed in the same year, from GUS migration for permanent residence and foreigners insured in ZUS, yearly), finwire_housing_pipeline (forecast of dwellings completed in 4 quarters up to 2 years ahead from GUNB building permits, 80% interval and backtest accuracy per horizon) and finwire_rent_forecast (6-month change of asking rent per m2, published only after passing the accuracy threshold). Present forecasts as model estimates with the interval and accuracy, never as certainty.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") one of 17 cities; omit for Poland and all cities.

tools.name: get_coal_waste_prices
tools.description: Use for the average price of a tonne of coal or the waste collection fee, in Poland and by province. Cena węgla finwire (finwire_coal_price_pl) and Opłata za odpady finwire (finwire_waste_fee_pl): annual average price of a tonne of hard coal and monthly fee for sorted waste collection per person in multi-family buildings, Poland and 16 provinces, from Statistics Poland (GUS). Annual averages for a past year, not current shop prices.

region.description: Province slug without diacritics, e.g. mazowieckie, slaskie, kujawsko-pomorskie; default all 16.

tools.name: get_housing_costs
tools.description: Use for the running costs of a flat. Monthly running costs of a flat in 20 largest cities: co-op and owners association charges per m², heating, electricity, gas, water and waste rates, each with year and scope (city or province).

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") ; omit for the list of cities.

tools.name: get_credit_market
tools.description: Use for the state of the mortgage market: lending criteria, demand and new loans. Polish housing loan market: topic "index" (finwire 0-100 credit market index, returns finwire_credit_market_index), "survey" (NBP bank lending survey: criteria and demand), "monetary" (NBP household loans and deposits, new housing loans), "demand" (BIK Demand Index for housing loans, average requested vs granted amount, granted loans y/y according to BIK, new housing loans from NBP).

tools.name: get_rate_risk
tools.description: Use when the user asks if a mortgage payment will rise. Also use for the payment in a year and the fixed against variable rate premium. finwire model on WIBOR fixings and bank offers: finwire_rate_risk_gauge (Ryzyko raty finwire) - chance that the payment of a PLN 400,000, 30-year variable-rate mortgage rises by more than 5% or 10% (or falls by more than 5%) in 3, 6 and 12 months, with the 10th/50th/90th percentile of the payment and backtest accuracy since 2008 (80% interval coverage); finwire_fixed_rate_premium (Premia za stałą stopę finwire) - the typical 5-year fixed rate minus the expected cost of the variable rate over 5 years, in pp, daily and monthly (ECB MIR), with windows of a negative premium. A model estimate, not a certainty and not advice.

history.description: Number of past daily readings in the summary, default 10.

tools.name: get_bank_rates
tools.description: Use for market rates of mortgages, cash loans, deposits, savings accounts and retail bonds, and for the cost of personal accounts (all, for young people and children, foreign currency). For NBP rates, use get_interest_rates. Aggregates of offers currently on the market (median and percentiles, no single bank offers): mortgage APRC and margin, cash loan APRC, term deposit and savings account rates; annual personal account cost by group (product "accounts": all accounts, young people and children, or foreign currency account fees from the KNF comparison); or retail government bond rates (product "bonds"). finwire indices of the best offers (finwire_mortgage_barometer, finwire_deposit_rate_index, finwire_savings_rate_index, finwire_account_cost_index): get_finwire_index.

product.description: Product: mortgage, cash loan, term deposit, savings account, personal accounts or retail government bonds.

period.description: Mortgage: years; cash loan and deposit: months.

group.description: Accounts only: all (default), young (accounts for young people and children) or fx (foreign currency accounts).

tools.name: get_legal_limits
tools.description: Use for statutory values of this year: IKE and IKZE limits, PIT and minimum wage. For next year, use get_next_year_limits (property tax: get_property_tax_next_year). Statutory values for the current year: IKE and IKZE contribution limits, PIT thresholds and rates, tax-free amount, capital gains tax, rental flat-rate tax, minimum wage and other limits, company social benefits fund (ZFŚS) allowance per employee with transfer deadlines, and the GUS life expectancy table (months at ages 55-75, current and previous edition) that ZUS uses to compute pensions; business limits in euro (small VAT, PIT and CIT taxpayer, flat-rate tax eligibility, de minimis one-off depreciation, full accounting threshold) in PLN for the previous, current and next year at the NBP rate from the law, fiscal penal code fines and thresholds, company car private use amounts; topic "local-tax" gives the upper limits of local property tax rates. Company tax regimes (CIT, Estonian CIT, IP Box) and business rules: get_business_guide.

tools.name: get_next_year_limits
tools.description: Use for next-year pension indexation, minimum wage, IKE and IKZE limits and ZUS bases before the official announcement. Tell the user that this is a formula estimate. Give the interval and the stage. Statutory values for the next year computed by finwire.pl from the formulas in Polish law on the latest GUS and NBP data, before the official act (finwire_next_year_limits): pension indexation and minimum pension, minimum wage and hourly rate (statutory minimum rise), projected average wage, IKE and IKZE limits, the 30x ZUS cap, ZUS contribution bases, flat-rate tax, small CIT, VAT and PIT taxpayer limits, de minimis depreciation limit, full accounting threshold and the petty fiscal offence threshold. Each item: value, 80% interval, stage (projekcja = estimate, projekt, obwieszczenie = announced, obowiazuje = in force), calculation and backtest accuracy. Present estimates as estimates; for values in force this year use get_legal_limits.

key.description: One item key, e.g. pension_indexation, min_wage, ike, ikze, pension_base_cap_30x, zus_full_base, ryczalt_limit, vat_small_taxpayer, full_accounting_threshold, kks_offence_threshold. Default all.

tools.name: get_property_tax_next_year
tools.description: Use for the property tax on a flat or a house next year: the highest rate a municipality can set per m², before and after the Minister of Finance announcement. Tell the user the stage; an estimate is not an official value. The municipality sets its own rate up to this limit. Upper limits of the local property tax for the next year (finwire_property_tax_cap), per m² of a flat or house and for the other 8 categories of art. 5 ust. 1 of the local taxes act, from the formula in art. 20: this year limit x GUS CPI index for the first half-year, rounded up to full grosz. Stage: szacunek (estimate from monthly CPI, with 80% interval), wskaznik_gus (final figure from the GUS notice), obwieszczenie (announced by the Minister of Finance), obowiazuje (in force). Optional m2 gives the yearly maximum tax for a flat of that size. Municipalities set their own rates up to these limits; for this year limits use get_legal_limits with topic local-tax.

m2.description: Usable floor area of a flat or house in m² for the yearly maximum tax.

tools.name: get_local_fees
tools.description: Use for local fees and their upper limits: tourist (local) fee and spa fee for a stay (per night from 2027), dog fee, market fee, advertising fee, tax on trucks, tractor units, trailers and buses, agricultural and forest tax per hectare. The municipality sets its own rate up to the limit; give the limit as a maximum. Upper limits of Polish local fees set yearly by the Minister of Finance: tourist (local) fee and spa fee (per day until 2026, per night from 1 January 2027: landscape resort, spa protection area, spa), dog fee per year, market fee per day, advertising fee, tax on trucks, tractor units, trailers and buses per year, and agricultural and forest tax per hectare from GUS rye and wood prices. Optional nights, persons and resort_type give the maximum tourist or spa fee for a stay (stays over 29 nights are exempt). Includes finwire_resort_fee_family_week (7 nights, 2 adults and 2 children). Municipalities set their own rates up to these limits.

nights.description: Nights of the stay for the tourist or spa fee.

resort_type.description: landscape = tourist fee in a landscape resort, spa_protection_area = tourist fee in a spa protection area, spa = spa fee. Default landscape.

tools.name: get_legal_changes
tools.description: Use for new laws and for the next PIT, ZUS and VAT deadlines. For the full yearly calendar of a business, use get_compliance_calendar. Acts of the Journal of Laws and Monitor Polski on personal finance, tax, labour and housing: entering into force soon and recently, with plain-language summaries, plus bills in the Sejm. Also returns the next 30 days of the finwire legal calendar (series finwire_legal_calendar): PIT, ZUS and VAT deadlines, IKE/IKZE year end, value changes, RPP meetings and bond sales.

days.description: Look-back window for recent acts, default 30.

tools.name: get_bills_awaiting_president
tools.description: Use for which acts wait for the signature of the President of Poland, how many days are left, and whether the President signed or vetoed an act. Give the Sejm and the Chancellery of the President as the source. Acts passed by the Polish parliament and presented to the President without a decision yet: day of presentation, deadline and days left. The President has 21 days from presentation (art. 122 ust. 2 of the Constitution), 7 days for the budget act (art. 224 ust. 1). Also the President's decisions of the last 30 days: signature, veto (refusal to sign, the act goes back to the Sejm) or referral to the Constitutional Tribunal, with the announcement of the Chancellery of the President. All acts, not only finance; finance=true keeps only acts on personal finance topics.

finance.description: true = only acts on tax, social security, credit, housing, wages and benefits. Default false (all acts).

query.description: Word from the act title (Polish) or print number, e.g. "towarów", "3293".

tools.name: check_knf_warnings
tools.description: Use to check if the KNF warnings list contains a company, an investment platform or a website. Look up a company, investment platform or website on the public warnings list of the Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF) by name, website domain, KRS, NIP or REGON. Returns matching entries verbatim from KNF (entity, identifiers, legal basis, prosecutor, final rulings, important information). An entry is a notification of a suspected offence, not a conviction; no match does NOT mean the firm is licensed or safe. Without query: list size, entries by legal basis, entries new this week and the weekly series finwire_knf_warnings_monitor.

query.description: Firm name (min. 3 characters), website (e.g. "tradereu.com") or KRS/NIP/REGON number.

tools.name: check_bfg_guarantee
tools.description: Use to check if the BFG deposit guarantee includes a bank or a credit union. Check whether a Polish bank or credit union (SKOK) is on the list of entities covered by the deposit guarantee of the Bankowy Fundusz Gwarancyjny (BFG), by name, trade name (e.g. "Inteligo") or website. Without query: counts of commercial banks, cooperative banks, credit unions and entities in bankruptcy (series finwire_bfg_guarantee_monitor) with history and latest changes, and the guarantee limit (EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank) with its PLN equivalent at the latest NBP rate. Branches of banks from other EU countries are covered by their home-country scheme, so no match for them is expected.

query.description: Bank or credit union name (min. 3 characters), trade name or website.

tools.name: get_tax_rulings
tools.description: Use for individual tax rulings by topic, for example rental income, crypto or IKE and IKZE. Individual tax rulings of the Polish tax information office (KIS) and municipal rulings on property tax, published in the EUREKA database of the Ministry of Finance, by topic: private rental (najem_prywatny), selling a flat and the housing relief (sprzedaz_nieruchomosci), IKE/IKZE (ike_ikze), crypto (kryptowaluty), shares, funds and dividends (inwestycje_pit38), sole proprietorship, lump-sum tax and IP Box (jdg_ryczalt), PIT reliefs (ulgi_pit), property tax (podatek_od_nieruchomosci). Returns counts per full week (series finwire_tax_rulings_pulse), provisions cited most often in the last 52 weeks and the newest rulings with signature, authority, dates, shortened thesis and a link to the full text. A ruling answers one taxpayer about their own case; it is not legal advice.

topic.description: Topic; omit for all topics with counts and a few newest rulings.

limit.description: Rulings to return for the topic, default 10.

tools.name: get_credit_judgments
tools.description: Use for court rulings in consumer credit disputes (CHF loans, WIBOR, free credit sanction, early repayment) and the share that borrowers won. Statistics of rulings of Polish common courts in consumer credit disputes, published in the Court Rulings Portal of the Ministry of Justice and classified by finwire.pl: CHF mortgages (chf), loans in EUR and other currencies (waluta_inna), free credit sanction under art. 45 of the Consumer Credit Act (skd), cost refunds after early repayment, Lexitor (wczesniejsza_splata), WIBOR clauses (wibor), unit-linked policies (polisolokata). Returns rulings per publication month, share ruled for the borrower at least in part in 12 full publication months (finwire_borrower_win_share, total and per category), first vs second instance, median time from claim to judgment and the newest rulings with case number, court, outcome and a link to the full text. Statistics of published rulings, not legal advice; each ruling concerns one contract.

category.description: Dispute category; omit for all categories.

tools.name: get_regional_data
tools.description: Use for data about municipalities and provinces: income, PIT, local tax, unemployment and wages. For the budget of one municipality, use get_municipal_budget. Regional data: "income" (residents income per capita by municipality, or county with level "powiat"), "pit" (PIT due per resident from tax returns by municipality and province, by type of return, PIT-38 capital gains returns per 1000 residents, finwire_pit_per_capita; with name = one municipality year by year), "local-tax" (finwire_local_tax_squeeze: property tax as % of property tax + PIT share in municipal budget plans, provinces, cities, municipalities in the squeeze, upper limit of the property tax rate for flats; with name = matching municipalities), "unemployment" (registered unemployment by province), "wages" (average wage in the enterprise sector by province, and the official averages used in Polish law - quarterly and annual national economy average, forecast average wage, Q4 enterprise average, social fund base - with amount, period, day of application and what each one is used for: pension earning limits, PFRON, 30x cap, health contribution of lump-sum taxpayers, social fund; share of employees below the mean). Filter by name.

topic.description: income: residents income per capita. pit: PIT due per resident. local-tax: property tax share in municipal budgets. unemployment: registered unemployment by province. wages: average wage by province and the official averages used in law.

year.description: For pit: tax year; for local-tax: budget year; default latest.

tools.name: get_europe_data
tools.description: Use to compare Poland with the EU: house prices, mortgage rates, bond yields, household electricity and gas prices, and minimum wages. Poland compared with EU countries: "house-prices" (Eurostat house price index), "mortgage-rates" (ECB rates on new housing loans), "bond-yields" (10-year yields and spreads vs Germany and euro area), "overburden" and "overcrowding" (housing conditions), "energy-prices" (household electricity or gas prices per kWh in EUR and purchasing power standards, half-yearly, with finwire_eu_power_price_gap and kWh per minimum wage), "minimum-wages" (statutory minimum wages in EUR and PPS, half-yearly).

topic.description: house-prices: Eurostat index. mortgage-rates: ECB rates on new housing loans. bond-yields: 10-year yields and spreads. overburden and overcrowding: housing conditions. energy-prices: household electricity or gas. minimum-wages: statutory minimum wages.

compare.description: For energy-prices and minimum-wages: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) to compare with Poland, default DE.

tools.name: get_family_benefits
tools.description: Use for how many children get 800 plus or Aktywny Rodzic (babciowe, nursery, at home) and how much ZUS pays, in Poland, by voivodeship and by municipality (gmina). Give ZUS as the source. Monthly statistics of ZUS (Polish Social Insurance Institution) on the child benefit 800 plus (świadczenie wychowawcze) and the three Aktywny Rodzic benefits (aktywni rodzice w pracy - working parents and aktywnie w domu - at home, both for children aged 12-35 months; aktywnie w żłobku - nursery fee): benefits paid in the latest month with year-on-year change, PLN paid in the month and since January, average payment, children paid, 800 plus applications, granted and refusals since January, the share of each Aktywny Rodzic variant in Poland and in a chosen voivodeship, and the finwire index finwire_child_benefits_payout (PLN billion paid in the month for all four benefits). Also the family benefits paid by municipalities (świadczenia rodzinne) from the Council of Ministers regulation: family allowance (zasiłek rodzinny) by age of the child, all supplements, income thresholds per person, the zlotowka za zlotowke rule, birth grant (becikowe), care benefit (zasiłek pielęgnacyjny), special care allowance, the benefit period and the next review dates; the nursing benefit świadczenie pielęgnacyjne for this and next year (computed from the minimum wage); Dobry Start; and the finwire index finwire_family_allowance_real (family allowance in prices of the month of the last review, GUS CPI). For the amount of 800 plus, deadlines and how much it grows when saved see the finwire.pl page linked in the result.

voivodeship.description: Optional voivodeship name in Polish (e.g. "mazowieckie") or TERYT code (e.g. "14").

gmina.description: Optional municipality (gmina) name in Polish, diacritics optional (e.g. "szczecin", "lodz"), or TERYT code; returns up to 10 matches with 800 plus per 1000 residents and Aktywny Rodzic shares.

history.description: Number of past months of the index in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_consumer_bankruptcies
tools.description: Use for the number of people who declare consumer bankruptcy in Poland, by month and year. Give COIG as the source. Number of people declared bankrupt as consumers in Poland per month, compiled by COIG (Centralny Ośrodek Informacji Gospodarczych) from court announcements in the National Register of Debtors (KRZ) and Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy: the latest month with year-on-year change, the sum since January against the same period a year earlier, the last 12 months, the rank of the latest month in the whole series and among the same calendar month, highest and lowest month, yearly totals and the finwire index finwire_consumer_bankruptcies (consumer bankruptcies in the 12 months up to the month). Attribution to COIG is mandatory (data COIG, reuse with attribution; not CC BY). For the cost and rules of the procedure itself see the finwire.pl page linked in the result.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_pit_settlement_stats
tools.description: Use for how many people in Poland settle PIT, how many are in the second tax bracket and what share of tax they pay, how many use child relief, IKZE or other reliefs, overpayments, flat tax and lump-sum tax returns. For PIT by municipality, use get_regional_data. For tax rates and limits, use get_legal_limits. National statistics of the annual PIT settlement from the yearly Ministry of Finance information (every tax year since 2019): taxpayers on the tax scale, returns by form (PIT-36, PIT-36L, PIT-37, PIT-38, PIT-39, PIT-28 lump-sum), taxpayers in the first and second bracket with the threshold and the second bracket share in tax due, reliefs deducted from income (IKZE, thermal modernisation, internet, rehabilitation, donations, trade union dues) with taxpayers, amount and average, child relief (taxpayers, children, amount), overpayments in returns, flat tax, capital gains and crypto income, and the finwire index finwire_pit_top_bracket_multiplier. Optional year selects one tax year. For PIT by municipality use get_regional_data; for tax rates and limits use get_legal_limits.

year.description: Tax year; default the latest published.

tools.name: get_rkm_price_limits
tools.description: Use for the maximum price per m2 in the family housing loan without down payment (rodzinny kredyt mieszkaniowy, BGK guarantee) in a city or voivodeship, and to check if a flat qualifies. Give BGK as the source and the quarter. Maximum price per m2 of a flat that can be bought with the Polish family housing loan (rodzinny kredyt mieszkaniowy, "Mieszkanie bez wkładu własnego": mortgage without down payment, BGK guarantees the missing part), from the quarterly lists of Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego based on voivode announcements. 52 locations: each voivodeship city, the municipalities bordering it and all other municipalities. Two limits: first buyer from the developer and secondary market or cooperative right. Gives change vs previous quarter and year, history, an optional check of a price per m2 against the limit, and the finwire index finwire_rkm_offer_fit (share of developer price-list flats in voivodeship cities within the limit). Also gives the state of government housing programmes (family housing loan deadline, Safe Loan 2% closed to new applications, withdrawn bills Pierwsze klucze and #naStart often called the 0% loan, draft amendments with their Sejm stage): use it for questions about a 0% or 2% mortgage or a housing programme. Attribution to BGK is mandatory (not CC BY).

location.description: Voivodeship city (Kraków), voivodeship (małopolskie) or key (krakow, krakow-okolice, malopolskie-pozostale). Default: all voivodeship cities.

market.description: primary = first buyer from the developer, secondary = previous owner or cooperative right. Default primary.

price_per_m2.description: Price per m2 in PLN to check against the limit of the first matching location.

quarters.description: Number of past quarters in the history, default 4.

tools.name: get_parking_prices
tools.description: Use for the price of a parking space, a garage space or a storage room from developers in a Polish city, and how it compares with the price of 1 m2 of a new flat. Say that these are asking prices from developer price lists and give the week. Asking prices of parking spaces sold by housing developers in Poland, from the daily price-list files on dane.gov.pl (act on transparency of new-flat prices). Weekly median, quartiles and counts of single parking spaces for Poland and cities above the publication threshold, underground or garage-hall vs outdoor vs garage, storage rooms and bike boxes, how many square metres of a new flat in the same city one space costs, change vs 4 weeks earlier and a weekly trend. Finwire index finwire_dev_parking_price.

city.description: City name or slug (Warszawa, zielona-gora). Default: Poland with the city list.

weeks.description: Number of past weeks in the trend, default 12.

tools.name: get_pension_earning_limits
tools.description: Use for how much a pensioner or a disability pensioner can earn without a cut of the benefit in Poland, the 70% and 130% thresholds and their dates, and the reduction for a given income. Give ZUS as the source and say when a value is a finwire estimate before the ZUS announcement. Income thresholds for working pensioners in Poland (art. 104 of the act on pensions from FUS): above 70% of the average wage for the quarter the benefit is reduced by the excess, up to the maximum reduction; above 130% it is suspended. Old-age pensioners after the statutory retirement age (60 women, 65 men) have no limit. Current and next thresholds with dates, ZUS announcement or a finwire estimate from the GUS announcement before it, maximum reductions, annual thresholds and history. Optional check of one month: benefit type, benefit and income give the reduction.

income.description: Gross monthly income in PLN (for the self-employed: social insurance contribution base). Gives the effect on the benefit.

benefit.description: Gross monthly benefit in PLN, used with income.

benefit_type.description: old_age (emerytura), full_disability, partial_disability (renta z tytułu niezdolności do pracy), survivor (renta rodzinna for one person). Default old_age.

retirement_age.description: true when the old-age pensioner reached 60 (women) or 65 (men): no limit. Default false.

quarters.description: Number of past quarters in the history, default 8.

tools.name: get_savings_bond_sales
tools.description: Use for how many savings bonds people buy in Poland, which series sell best, the sum since January against earlier years, IKE and IKZE purchases and buyer age. For bonds against deposits, use get_retail_bond_premium. For the rate in the next interest period, use get_bond_next_rate. Retail savings bonds of the State Treasury sold in Poland per month, from the Ministry of Finance statistics on gov.pl (since January 2015): the latest month in PLN with month-on-month and year-on-year change, the share and amount of every series (OTS, ROR, DOR, TOS, COI, EDO, family ROS and ROD), money from the exchange of maturing bonds and new money, purchases on IKE and IKZE retirement accounts, sales channels, buyer age (natural persons), the sum since January with the rank against the same months of every year, the best month and year, and the finwire index finwire_savings_bond_sales (sales in the 12 months, PLN billion). For interest rates of the current issue use get_retail_bond_premium or get_bank_rates.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_eu_fuel_prices
tools.description: Use for fuel prices in other EU countries, Poland against the EU, and where to fill the tank on a trip abroad. Say that the prices are national averages. Prices of Euro-super 95 petrol, diesel, LPG or heating oil at filling stations in the 27 EU countries from the European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin (Monday prices, weekly since 2005): PLN and EUR per litre with all taxes, without taxes and tax share, rank from the cheapest, weekly change, a year earlier, the EU and euro area weighted averages, the difference for a full tank against Poland and the finwire index finwire_eu_fuel_price_gap. PLN prices use the NBP EUR mid rate of the reading day. These are national averages; motorway stations are usually more expensive.

country.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) to compare with Poland, default DE.

tank.description: Tank size in litres for the full-tank difference, default 50.

tools.name: get_eu_inflation
tools.description: Use for inflation in EU countries, the place of Poland in the EU and price growth since a year. For the CPI of Statistics Poland, use get_macro_indicator. Harmonised inflation (HICP, annual rate) in the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area from Eurostat, monthly since 2000: the latest month with Poland, ranking from the highest inflation, change vs the previous month, the place of Poland and the place a month and a year earlier, five components (core inflation, food, energy, services, industrial goods), price growth in every country since the same month of a chosen year (basket), the finwire index finwire_eu_inflation_gap (Polish HICP minus EU HICP, percentage points) and the euro area flash estimate when newer. With country: that country's monthly component history. HICP is the EU-comparable measure; for the national CPI of Statistics Poland use get_macro_indicator.

country.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for its component history and place; default Poland.

compare.description: EU country code added to the history next to Poland, default DE.

since.description: Start year of the basket (price growth since the same month of that year), default 2015.

tools.name: get_eu_unemployment
tools.description: Use to compare unemployment in Poland with EU countries, also youth unemployment. For registered unemployment in Polish voivodeships, use get_regional_data. Monthly unemployment rate in the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area from Eurostat (une_rt_m, seasonally adjusted, ILO definition from labour force surveys): total and persons under 25, rank from the lowest rate, change vs the previous month and a year earlier in percentage points, rank of Poland in every month since 2010, history of Poland, the EU, the euro area and one comparison country, and the finwire index finwire_eu_youth_unemployment_ratio (youth rate divided by the total rate in Poland). This is not the registered unemployment rate of Polish labour offices (GUS); for that and for voivodeships use get_regional_data with topic unemployment.

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat or ISO, Greece = EL or GR) to compare with Poland, default DE.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_eu_earnings
tools.description: Use for salaries and net pay in EU countries, how Polish pay compares with the EU or one country, and how a given net salary in PLN compares with the average in each EU country. For minimum wages, use get_europe_data. Annual net earnings (take-home pay after income tax and employee social contributions, plus family allowances) in the 27 EU countries from Eurostat earn_nt_net, yearly, by household type: single person, couples with and without children, single parent, low (67%) and high (167%) wage. Ranking in EUR and in purchasing power standards (PPS, adjusted for price levels), gross pay, tax and contributions, hourly labour cost of employers (lc_lci_lev), tax wedge of a low-wage single earner, the finwire index finwire_eu_net_wage_gap (Poland as % of the EU average in PPS) and the history of Poland and one comparison country. With salary (monthly net in PLN) it compares that pay with the average of the same household type in every EU country, in EUR and PPS, and gives the monthly EUR amount with the same purchasing power.

household.description: Household type, default single (single person without children, average wage).

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for the history next to Poland, default DE.

salary.description: Monthly net salary in PLN to compare with every EU country.

tools.name: get_eu_gdp
tools.description: Use for GDP per capita of EU countries, Poland against the EU in purchasing power, GDP growth of EU countries in a quarter, and when Poland could reach the EU average or another country. Tell the user that the catch-up year is arithmetic, not a forecast. GDP per capita of the 27 EU countries in purchasing power standards (PPS, EU27 = 100) and in EUR per inhabitant with the rank, real growth of GDP per capita (last year, 5- and 10-year averages), actual individual consumption per capita (AIC, EU27 = 100) and the price level of consumption, the latest quarter of real GDP growth (seasonally adjusted, quarter on quarter and year on year), the EU and the euro area, yearly history since 1995 of Poland, the EU and one country, and the finwire index finwire_eu_convergence_years (Licznik doganiania UE finwire): years until GDP per capita of Poland in PPS reaches the EU average at the average real growth of the last 10 years. Arithmetic on a constant pace, not a forecast.

country.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL), e.g. DE. Adds this country to the answer and the history. Default DE.

tools.name: get_eu_public_debt
tools.description: Use for government debt and deficit of EU countries and Poland against the EU, and for the 3% and 60% of GDP reference values. For Polish State Treasury debt per month, use get_public_debt. General government gross debt, deficit and interest as % of GDP in the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area (Eurostat): debt at the end of the latest quarter with the change in a year, deficit, interest and debt in the latest year from the excessive deficit procedure notification, ranks, countries above the 3% deficit and 60% debt reference values in the data (not the list of countries under the procedure), annual history of Poland, the EU and one comparison country, and finwire_eu_debt_threshold_gap (Poland quarterly debt minus 60, percentage points).

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for the history and the comparison with Poland, default DE.

tools.name: get_eu_living_conditions
tools.description: Use for how many people own their home with or without a mortgage or rent in EU countries, for people who cannot pay an unexpected expense (financial cushion) and for household income per person in EU countries. For house prices in the EU, use get_europe_data. For net pay, use get_eu_earnings. Yearly EU-SILC survey for the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area (Eurostat): share of people living in their own home without a mortgage, with a mortgage or housing loan, in market rent and in reduced rent or free (ilc_lvho02); share of people in households that cannot face an unexpected required expense from their own resources (ilc_mdes04); median and mean equivalised disposable income per year in EUR, PPS and PLN for Poland (ilc_di03, household income divided by the modified OECD scale; the survey year reports income of the previous year). Ranks, Poland against the EU and one comparison country with history since 2005, and two finwire indices: finwire_eu_mortgaged_owners (owners with a mortgage as % of all owners) and finwire_eu_household_income_gap (median income in Poland as % of the EU value in PPS).

topic.description: Ranking in the summary: housing (own home and mortgage), cushion (unexpected expense) or income; default all (Poland and the EU only).

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for the history and the comparison with Poland, default DE.

tools.name: get_deposit_bank_average
tools.description: Use for the average rate on new deposits in Polish banks by maturity, how much more the best deposits pay than the bank average, and the average rate and APRC of new consumer loans. With view=history: the average deposit rate since 2005 (last 10 or 20 years, historical data) and in how many years an average deposit beat inflation. For offers of single banks, use get_bank_rates. NBP interest rate statistics (MIR) for new household business in PLN: average rate on new term deposits (all maturities and by original maturity) with the value and share of new deposits by maturity, and the average rate and APRC (RRSO) of new consumer loans. With Premia za wybór lokaty finwire (finwire_deposit_choice_premium): how much more the finwire deposit index (5 best 3-month deposits) pays than the average new 1-3 month deposit, in pp and in PLN per year on PLN 10,000 after tax, plus a current estimate. With view=history: the average deposit rate monthly since 2005 by maturity, yearly averages against annual average CPI (GUS) and Realne oprocentowanie przeciętnej lokaty finwire (finwire_real_avg_deposit_rate): the real result of an average deposit year by year before and after tax and in how many years it beat inflation. Market averages, not an offer. Informational data, not investment advice.

view.description: latest (default): latest month, premium and consumer loans; history: average deposit rate since 2005, yearly real result against inflation.

history.description: Number of past months (view latest, default 12) or past years (view history, default all) in the summary.

tools.name: get_deposit_forecast
tools.description: Use when the user asks if deposit rates will fall or rise, or what deposits will pay in the next months. Tell the user that it is a model estimate. For NBP rate decisions, use get_nowcast. Finwire Depocast (finwire_deposit_rate_forecast): model forecast of the average rate on new household term deposits in Polish banks (NBP MIR) 1, 3 and 6 months after the latest NBP month, with an 80% interval, the assumed NBP reference rate and backtest accuracy (error, no-change error, interval coverage). Only horizons that passed the accuracy gate are returned; hiddenHorizons counts the others. Settled earlier forecasts are compared with NBP readings. It is a model estimate, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months of the NBP average in the summary, default 6.

tools.name: get_bank_penalties
tools.description: Use for fines imposed by UOKiK or KNF on a Polish bank, how many fines a bank had in the last 5 years and the sum, or which banks were fined most. For the KNF warnings list of unlicensed firms, use check_knf_warnings. For the BFG deposit guarantee, use check_bfg_guarantee. Fines imposed by the President of UOKiK (consumer protection) and by the Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF) on Polish banks described on finwire.pl, in the last 5 years: count and sum per bank (series finwire_bank_penalty_count; group companies such as mortgage banks, fund managers or leasing firms counted separately). With bank: the fines of that bank with the party verbatim from the source, amount (UOKiK press releases often give rounded amounts), dates, finality when the press release states it, and a link to the UOKiK press release or the KNF list. Matching uses current and former legal names (e.g. Santander Bank Polska = Erste Bank Polska); parties matched with lower confidence are left out. UOKiK fines start from the first press release read (the RSS feed has no history). Information only, not an assessment of the bank.

bank.description: Bank page slug on finwire.pl, e.g. pko-bp, mbank, ing, pekao, erste, millennium, alior, bnp-paribas, credit-agricole, velobank; omit for all banks.

limit.description: Fines to list for the bank, default 20.

tools.name: get_household_inflation
tools.description: Use for inflation of retirees and pensioners (inflacja emerycka), which price index the pension indexation formula takes this year, and inflation for family types or income groups. For overall CPI, use get_macro_indicator. Give GUS as the source and the month; say that averages are finwire.pl approximations and not a forecast of the indexation rate. Retiree inflation (inflacja emerycka): Statistics Poland CPI y/y for households of retirees and pensioners (together, retirees and pensioners separately) vs total CPI, monthly since 2018; year-to-date and annual averages of monthly readings (finwire.pl approximation, checked on total CPI against the official annual index); which index is higher under art. 89(2) of the Polish pension act (pension indexation takes the retirees and pensioners index unless total CPI is higher; this describes the data, it is not a forecast); basket shares by COICOP division from Statistics Poland CPI weights. Also Inflacja gospodarstw domowych finwire (finwire_household_inflation_index: CPI for family types and income quintiles, finwire.pl method) and official CPI by socio-economic group.

months.description: Months of retiree inflation history in the summary, default 12.

tools.name: get_household_savings
